setting: A student is speaking with a dining services employee about changing her meal plan.
narrator_intro: Listen to a conversation between a student and a dining services employee.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Hi, I signed up for the nineteen-meal plan at the start of the semester, but I barely use more than ten a week. Can I switch to something smaller?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Let me check. Yes, you can switch to the fourteen-meal plan, but changes can only happen during the first three weeks of the semester or during winter break.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: We're only in week two, so I should be fine, right?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Correct, you're within the window. Keep in mind, though, once you switch, any unused meals from the nineteen-plan this week won't roll over, they reset with the new plan.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: That's fine, I've already lost a few meals anyway since I keep forgetting to eat on campus during exam weeks.

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: That happens a lot. One more thing, the fourteen-meal plan comes with fewer guest swipes, only two a semester instead of five. Is that going to be an issue?

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: No, I don't usually bring guests anyway. Let's go ahead and make the switch.

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Great, I'll process it now. It'll take effect starting tomorrow morning.

narrator_outro: Now get ready to answer the questions.

questions.narrator_text: What is the woman trying to do?

options.B: Switch to a meal plan with fewer meals
options.C: Add more guest swipes to her account
options.D: Complain about the quality of dining hall food

questions.explanation: She explains she barely uses ten meals a week and wants to switch from nineteen to a smaller plan.

questions.narrator_text: Why is the woman able to make the change now?

options.A: She has a special exception from the dean
options.B: It is within the first three weeks of the semester
options.D: She never used any meals from her original plan

questions.explanation: The staff member confirms changes are allowed during the first three weeks, and it is only week two.

questions.narrator_text: What will happen to her unused meals from this week?

options.A: They will be refunded as credit
options.B: They will roll over to the new plan
options.C: They will not carry over to the new plan
options.D: They will be donated to a campus food bank

questions.explanation: The staff member explains unused meals reset and do not roll over when switching plans.

questions.narrator_text: What difference does the staff member point out about guest swipes?

options.A: The new plan has more guest swipes
options.B: The new plan has fewer guest swipes
options.C: Guest swipes are being removed entirely

questions.explanation: He mentions the fourteen-meal plan includes only two guest swipes instead of five.
